thread:
maria: quick ping — PR #2384 is ready for final review, small refactor: extracted a `backoff` helper from request_batcher to make retries clearer. mainly style nits left, CI is mostly green but lint flagged a couple things.
jamal: will take a look in a bit. any behavioral changes or just extraction?
owen: skimmed — no behavior changes afaict, just a couple naming + formatting nits.
amelia: @maria can you add a one-line changelog in the commit? makes release notes easier.
maria: yep will add. main nits from me: function name `calcBackoff` should be `calcBackoffMs`? or maybe `backoffMillis` to match the rest of the codebase. also there's an unused import in batcher.go (fmt).
jamal: prefer `backoffMillis` (we've standardized on units in names). also pls avoid `Ptr` suffix on tiny helpers — we had a lint rule about that.
owen: formatting: run `gofmt -w .` and then `git commit --amend --no-edit` — CI lint should pass after that. there was a trailing comma in the struct literal that the formatter fixed locally.
ci-bot: CI update — unit tests: passed, integration tests: passed, linters: failed (gofmt, govet). see: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/2384
alex: small nit: the helper returns (int, error) but it never returns an error in current code path. either remove the error or add a comment explaining future error cases.
sara: for the rename, prefer a separate commit for the naming change so the refactor + naming are clearly separable in blame. tiny preference but helps debugging.
maria: ok i'll split into two commits: 1) extract helper, 2) rename and cleanup. i'll run gofmt and drop the fmt import. i'll push in ~10m.
jamal: sounds good — i'll review after your push. if you split commits, mark the second as `style:` so release notes ignore it.
owen: also add a short unit test for the helper edge case (0 delay -> 0 backoff). takes 2 lines.
maria: will add test.
ci-bot: status change — new commit pushed by maria. CI queued.
ci-bot: CI update — linters: passed, unit tests: passed, integration: flaky (one timeout) — rerunning flaky job.
alex: if the integration flakes again, don't block merge window — we can retry and merge on green.
maria: pushing fixups now (gofmt + test + split commits). planning to merge in the 4pm merge window unless anyone objects.
jamal: no objections, i'll re-approve once tests are green.
owen: quick approve from me after CI: :shipit: (will do final review after the second commit).
sara: LGTM for style split. thanks for splitting.
maria: thanks all — i'll post final link when merged. :thumbsup:
